report.interpretation: Good — Tests exercise the core happy-path and error-passthrough contracts solidly, but the global/hybrid retrieval branch, the LiteLLM fallback chain, and the entire text2cypher module are pseudo-tested. High structural coverage (74% baseline) masks three significant fault-detection voids. Address high-priority survivors and enforce boundary testing on the router's mode dispatch.
report.survived_mutants:
• router.py:95 — NegateConditionals: `if mode in ("global", "hybrid"):` → `if mode not in (...)`. Survived because every test in test_router.py either hardcodes search_mode="local" or uses a mock that returns {"mode": "local"}. The global/hybrid execution branch (lines 95–148) is confirmed missed in htmlcov. No test ever forces mode="global" or mode="hybrid", so the entire community-summary retrieval path is invisible to the suite.
• router.py:92 — InlineConstantMutator: `top_k=8` (hardcoded in reranker.rerank call). Survived because test_reranker_called_with_retrieved_chunks only asserts `mock_rr.rerank.assert_called()` — it never inspects the `top_k` keyword argument. Mutating the constant to 0 or 99 produces no failing assertion.
• text2cypher.py (any line, e.g. query construction logic) — AOR/ROR/ReturnValues. Survived because no test_text2cypher.py exists. The router fixture patches `Text2CypherRetriever` at the class level (`patch("graphnotebook.retrieval.router.Text2CypherRetriever")`), meaning the internal logic of text2cypher.py is never invoked. htmlcov confirms 56% coverage (24/43 stmts, 19 missing) sourced entirely from import-time execution.
• gateway.py (fallback chain, ~lines 45–65 estimated from 14 missing stmts) — RemoveConditionals: removing the `if self.fallbacks:` guard or the fallback retry loop. Survived because test_invoke_uses_task_model only verifies the primary model kwarg on a successful call. No test injects a primary-model failure to trigger the fallback chain. The 14 missing gateway.py lines are exclusively in the error/retry path.
report.equivalent_mutants:
• config.py:uploads_dir property — VoidMethodCallRemoval on `os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)`. The side-effect (directory creation) cannot be observed by any existing assertion; all Settings tests only read field values. The property's return value is unchanged whether makedirs executes or not within the test sandbox. Heuristic: unsatisfiable propagation condition — the infected state (filesystem) never propagates to a test oracle.
• graph/queries.py (Cypher string constants, e.g. UPSERT_DOCUMENT) — StringMethodsMutator on constant body text. Neo4j is uniformly mocked via mock_neo4j.query.return_value = [] across all tests; the Cypher string is passed as an argument but never parsed or validated. The mutation infects the string but the propagation to an observable output is blocked by the mock barrier. Heuristic: unsatisfiable propagation condition.
report.unproductive_mutants:
• pipeline.py:error logging strings (e.g. `f"Embed/Store failed: {e}"`) — StringMethodsMutator on the error message literal. The tests assert `result["error"] == "upstream boom"` (passthrough of upstream error), never the formatted string produced in the except block. Changing "Embed/Store failed: " to "Embed/Store error: " produces no test failure. Classification: logging/diagnostic string — no oracle validates it.
• config.py:Settings field `data_dir = "./data"` — InlineConstantMutator. No test sets a relative-path assertion against data_dir. The field exists but is only used downstream in `uploads_dir` and `cache_dir` properties which themselves have no oracle in the test suite.
report.weaknesses:
• CRITICAL — Untested retrieval modes: The global and hybrid query paths in router.py (lines 95–148) are completely unexercised. This is not a coverage gap — it is a functional blindspot. Any regression in community-summary retrieval, map-reduce orchestration, or global_search.GlobalSearcher.search() would go undetected. (router.py:95–148)
• HIGH — No top_k contract on router→reranker integration: router.py:92 hardcodes top_k=8 but no test verifies this value propagates correctly to the reranker. A misconfiguration silently changes retrieval depth. (router.py:92)
• HIGH — text2cypher.py entirely pseudo-tested: 56% structural coverage achieved only through import-time execution. The query construction, parameter binding, and result normalization inside Text2CypherRetriever are completely unmutated by any assertion. (text2cypher.py, all business logic)
• HIGH — LiteLLM fallback chain untested: gateway.py's fallback retry logic (~14 missing lines) has zero test coverage. A broken fallback silently degrades to no response rather than attempting fallback models. (gateway.py:45–65 estimated)
• MODERATE — notebooks/manager.py under-tested: 76% coverage with 21 missing lines and no dedicated test file. CRUD operations for notebook isolation — a critical multi-tenancy feature — have no unit assertions. (notebooks/manager.py)
• MODERATE — kg_pipeline.py at 52%: KGConstructor._build_pipeline and the SimpleKGPipeline wiring are untested; only the happy-path ingest_text call via AsyncMock is exercised. Schema enforcement logic cannot be mutation-tested. (extraction/kg_pipeline.py:41–54)
• LOW — router.py max-iteration guard unverified: The sufficiency/retry loop's ceiling (preventing infinite LangGraph cycles) is asserted only weakly — test checks `call_count >= 1` rather than `== MAX_ITER` semantics. A ConditionalsBoundary mutation on the iteration threshold would survive. (router.py, iteration guard)
